languages.name: Python
languages.summary: From the first line to data structures and algorithms, in the order the videos teach them.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.summary: Syntax, types, control flow, functions, the built-in collections, errors, files and modules. No experience needed.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.summary: The language's own idioms, classic data structures and algorithms, testing and packaging.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.summary: Concurrency, performance, metaprogramming, graphs, dynamic programming and internals.
